requirements.name: geometry
requirements.check: Decode assets/error-retry.png as exactly one static 16x16 frame; no strip, animation or extra canvas.
requirements.reason: Fresh decode records exact target geometry: Working64x16, Retry/Paused16x16. All actual rendered crops match source dimensions and horizontal cell rectangles.

requirements.name: transparent-exterior-measured
requirements.check: MEASURED record (mechanical/local, diagnostic): retain every cell's alpha histogram and exact RGBA component boxes (zero-based, half-open). FLAG for visual review any alpha>0 component touching all four cell edges, or any single alpha>0 component covering more than half of the cell's 256 pixels. The flag is a diagnostic proxy for a canvas matte or grey tile and is NOT a rejection condition (a corner-to-corner X or full-span glyph legitimately touches all four edges with a transparent exterior). RGB values of alpha-0 pixels are not significant. No mechanical rejection rule is decidable for this static member (no construction fixes its alpha set); the measured record is diagnostic only.
requirements.reason: Fresh per-cell alpha histograms, exact RGBA boxes and4-connected components retained. Flags are diagnostic only. Working seed-rotation alpha and visibleRGBA equality pass all4cells under the scoped seed-rotation proposal; selective/full alpha remains permitted.

requirements.name: transparent-exterior-visual
requirements.check: VISUAL record (visual/visual; the deciding rule): viewed at 1x and 3x on #172336, the exterior of the image shows the panel with no unintended matte, tile, plate, halo or fringe; a deliberate opaque backing shape is acceptable only when it is part of the mark's recorded design and the exterior stays transparent. Partial alpha on mark pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.
requirements.reason: Viewed native and3x colour/gray marks and rendered panel exterior. Negative space remains panel; no unintended solid tile, fringe or halo. Alpha diagnostics were not used as the deciding visual rule.

requirements.name: retry-meaning-without-color
requirements.check: Viewed at 1x and 3x nearest on #172336 in colour and in a non-colour comparison (grayscale or binarized silhouettes), the mark reads as failed work with a retry action and is identifiable by shape alone against Ready, every Working frame including the held cell, Paused and the preserved Start triangle; in particular it must not be confusable with the Working activity loop or its held cell. No specific retry motif (such as an arrow) is required.
requirements.reason: The circular return arrow with visible arrowhead conveys retry and remains distinct from Ready check, separated activity clusters, paired pause bars and Start triangle in grayscale/native/3x.

requirements.name: style-coherence
requirements.check: Readable compact silhouette(s), deliberate coherent clusters and stepped edges consistent with the exact Ready baseline (selective, intentional anti-aliasing is permitted under the full-alpha contract; accidental resampling blur or stray noise is not), and a perceptible cool-blue accent related to the Ready baseline and the preserved Start accent, judged qualitatively at 1x and 3x on #172336; no exact hex, palette count, binary alpha, stroke width or margin rule.
requirements.reason: Native/3x colour and gray views show compact readable silhouettes, deliberate stepped clusters and related perceptible cool-blue accents against exact Ready. Start remains vector control/color reference. No palette-count,alpha,stroke-width or margin gate imposed.
